newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica bonds off strongest levels, rand steady.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica bonds off strongest levels, rand steady.

text.p: 1415 GMT - Bonds retrace some gains in late trader as U.S. Treasuries fall after stronger-that-expected March U.S. industrial output data.
* R150 last at 15.14 pct from 15.20 pct at 1400 GMT on Tuesday and intraday low of 15.09 pct. Good two-way trade seen during day and dealers say players keen to go long stock at current levels.
Some bond traders expecting more strength on Thursday with 15 pct key level to watch for break on the downside.

* Rand around day's weakest levels but little changed on the day after consistent importer demand during afternoon. Mkt caught slightly short Tuesday and players now buying back dollars, forex traders say.
* Outlook seen positive with interest from offshore to buy rand at higher levels. Range seen between 4.4500 to 4.4650.
Last at 4.4575/4605 vs easier dollar from 4.4590/4620 overnight.
